messages:
maya: deploy-bot just flagged canary on slimline v4.2.1-hotfix — auth cache errors showing up. 5% canary, starting 13:10 UTC. Need expedited decision: rollback to v4.2.0 or apply quick patch and re-run canary?

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary summary: started 13:10 UTC -> 5% US-E/EU-W. Alerts: auth.refresh 502 spike +8% (threshold 5%). Link: https://deploys.internal/reports/1768923012

sam: scope? only token refresh or all auth endpoints?

maya: token refresh mainly. Intermittent 502/504 to upstream auth on cache-miss. Stage reproduces. Static pages unaffected but new-user flows impacted.

julian: oncall team running quick smoke now. Prefer rollback unless patch <15m. What do we think of a config TTL bump?

oncall: smoke x3 -> 2/3 failed on /auth/refresh. Logs show "cache-miss -> upstream 504". CPU/memory stable. Looks like TTL or fallback key race.

rachel: ops stance: prefer rollforward w/ config tweak if it can be deployed fast and observed. Rollback causes longer customer impact for new sessions.

maya: ive got a tiny patch: bump auth KV TTL 30s -> 120s and add fallback-key check before upstream call. Diff is 3 lines. Deploy plan: apply patch to canary, wait 30m observation, then promote to stable. Need expedited approval from release and infra leads.

alex: +1 to rollforward if canary re-runs and failures go <2% within observation window. Need a clear kill-switch plan.

rachel: +1 but require emergency config change flagged in audit and metric alert suppressed for 40m to avoid noisy pages. Also add feature-flag fallback.

julian: add a short release note and 45m change window for customer comms.

maya: noted. Who can run the patched canary?

sam: i can kick it off in ~2m.

deploy-bot: /deploy canary --service slimline --ver v4.2.1-hotfix-patch queued by sam at 13:28 UTC. Steps: 1) route 5% traffic to new pod set 2) apply config 3) health checks 4) smoke.

sam: patch applied. healthchecks green. smoke 10/10 passing locally.

oncall: metrics: auth.refresh error back to baseline, latency +0.6ms. Observing for 30m.

rachel: emergency approval: granted for full rollout after successful 30m observation. Ensure audit log entry: "emergency-quickpatch-1768923012".

sam: promoting now -> /deploy promote --service slimline --to stable --ver v4.2.1-hotfix-patch --force (approved).

deploy-bot: promote started 13:36 UTC by sam. Regions stepped: US-E, EU-W, AP-S. 100% by 13:42 UTC. Post-deploy checks: all green. Auto-rollback disabled for this change window.

maya: closing loop. Thanks all for quick turnaround :tada: Please add a short line to release-notes and ops-runbook about the auth TTL fallback for next week audit.

alex: added release note draft in #release-notes-drafts.

mike: (react) :thumbsup:
